README: Canonical operator-scope permission payload (#3835). CC reads only `agent` and `subagentStatusLine` from a plugin settings.json (binary-proven at 2.1.226 and 2.1.251), so rules only enforce from the OPERATOR's own scopes: ~/.claude/settings.json, <project>/.claude/settings.json, or their .local variants. scripts/write-operator-permissions.mjs delivers this payload there with consent; doctor's check-operator-permissions.sh audits presence. The three SQL substrings the old dangerous-command-blocker matched (drop database / drop schema / truncate table inside a psql -c string) are NOT expressible as Bash() rules; that loss was accepted by operator decision 2026-08-31.
changelog: v3 (2026-08-31, #3849): the two find rules were inert as shipped. Bash(find:*-delete*) measured identical to no rule at all (0 permission_denials, the file deleted), while Bash(find *-delete*) denies. CC's colon form is a prefix separator, so it only matches as cmd:* and text placed after the star kills the match. Both rules were copied verbatim from src/settings/ork.settings.json, which CC never reads, so nothing had ever exercised their syntax. v2 (2026-08-31, #3835 wave 3): file-guard's PROTECTED_PATTERNS ported as Edit()/Write() deny rules (credentials.json, secrets.json, *.pem, private.key, id_rsa, id_ed25519, .husky/) before the hook was deleted. v1: the 26 never-enforced rules plus rm -fr twins, mv to /dev/null and .env Read/Edit/Write.
